name: Wildworld
idea: Multiplayer wildlife park + creature collection/breeding sim (Planet Zoo x Slime Rancher x Pokemon inspired, all original). Explore, capture original creatures, build habitats, breed for genetics + rare mutations, earn from visitors, visit/trade securely.

log.text: Multiplayer wildlife park + creature collection/breeding sim (Planet Zoo x Slime Rancher x Pokemon inspired, all original). Explore, capture original creatures, build habitats, breed for genetics + rare mutations, earn from visitors, visit/trade securely.
[gameplay] Make beautiful habitats the optimal strategy: habitat rating multiplies income; cheap server-state/client-lerp creature AI; Mendelian genes + Heirloom mutation boost
[ui] Reuse plant-zoo premium Kit reskinned as field-journal; one shared CreatureCard; breeding shows odds/ranges not promises; every build key has an on-screen button
[art] Code-built chibi creatures (12-20 rounded parts, role-tagged colours) + role-based mutation layers; ShadowMap lighting; client procedural animation with distance tiers
[audio] Marimba/vibes music, sparse; biome bed+one-shot ambience; creature voices = species pitch + mutation modifiers; 5-tier one-key stingers w/ ducking, legendary <=3.5s
Research merged: beautiful parks = best income; code-built creatures; 4 MVP mutations; open Q for Charlie: parts vs AI meshes
Hatch, catch and breed cute original creatures, chase Golden/Albino/Crystal mutations, and build them a beautiful park visitors pay to see.
Decided: code-built creatures only; trading = update 1 (visits+Likes in v1); same-species breeding only in v1

Audio done: 90 named sounds, zone music with silences, ambience beds + 3D one-shots, rarity stinger ladder with ducking, per-species creature voices. 22 Id=0 in README Charlie TODO; 4 contract questions in QUESTIONS.md.

Client procedural animation done: Goal-driven walking (client also moves Hitbox), idle/blink/ears/tail/legs, moods (sleep/eat/hungry/happy), personality idle actions, Hatch with delayed mutation reveal, egg wobble+crack, visitors + Tips coin fountain, tree sway, lantern flicker, placement thud; LOD tiers + one BulkMoveTo. See notes/animation.md; 5 [animation] items in QUESTIONS.md.

World built in code: hub w/ Heart Tree, 8 plots (Plot tag on Base part), Greenleaf Forest 3 zones + lake/waterfall, 14-min day cycle, 35 item visuals (ItemModels hook), 5 code-built creatures + Golden/Albino/Crystal/Glowing layers (CreatureBlueprints.Build hook). Tags in notes/graphics.md.

Gameplay built: creature AI, building grid, genetics/breeding, capture, session-locked saves, validated remotes, economy/quests/daily/shop/weather/visits/monetization. 6 questions in QUESTIONS.md; notes/gameplay.md has the remote list.

UI done: field-journal Kit port, HUD + 6 unlockable side buttons, first-60s tutorial (TutorialStep), Collection/Inspect/Breeding/Reveal/Build tray/Journal/Park/Shop/Daily/Visit/Settings, aligned to notes/gameplay.md remotes. See notes/ui.md

Decided 19 open items: zone ids Meadow/Hollow/Glade(+Park); wild creatures tagged Creature; settings saved via SaveSettings; Capture Moment + plot Tips signals from gameplay; client-only egg burst; Graphics owns CreatureBuilder; LikeBonusCap 10; favourites skipped v1
